items.title: ChatGPT Ads New Call-To-Actions, Business Agents Expand, More Audience Metrics & More
items.excerpt: OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads product update: Business Agents expand outside the U.S., a new 'learn more' CTA on single-image ads, more audience metrics in Ads Manager and the Ads API, an option to hide product-feed sale prices after a promotion ends, and new policy changes.

items.title: ChatGPT ad reports add 9 metrics built on how many people see the ads
items.excerpt: OpenAI added nine audience metrics to ChatGPT Ads Manager and the Ads API, led by Reach and Frequency (impressions divided by reach); reports previously counted only impressions and clicks. Business Agents also leave the US, though qualifying countries are unnamed.

items.title: OpenAI Isn't Planning Prompt-Level Reports For ChatGPT Ads
items.excerpt: ChatGPT ads match to queries OpenAI's own system writes; advertisers can't see them, and OpenAI says prompt-level reports aren't planned. SEJ lays out what that means for buyers.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads Hit 100,000 Advertisers - But Are They Seeing Results?
items.excerpt: With ChatGPT Ads past 100,000 advertisers, SEJ argues buyers should judge the channel on qualified leads and sales, since cheap clicks and Google Search benchmarks can mislead.

items.title: AI Agent Traffic to Surge 150x This Cyber Week, Driven Mostly by Meta Muse
items.excerpt: New data forecasts AI-agent traffic to retail sites surging 150x over Cyber Week, with Meta's Muse personal assistant accounting for the vast majority of agent-led site requests.

items.title: Target's New AI Assistant Is Just For Browsing, For Now
items.excerpt: Target's Ask Target assistant can't yet place orders on behalf of customers or manage account details heading into Black Friday; Adweek looks at what it does and where agentic checkout is headed.

items.title: Google patent describes an AI TV channel that stars the viewer
items.excerpt: A Google patent application feeds viewing history, age, gender and a profile photo into an AI prompt to generate a personalized video channel, and claim 4 covers stitching ads into each generated video.

items.title: IAB Europe gives publishers a 90-day plan for AI bots, deals and ads
items.excerpt: IAB Europe's agentic-web playbook has publishers score 12 areas out of 36 points, set rules for seven AI uses and weigh six ways to charge AI agents and bots, with no prices given.

items.title: AI 도구에서 AI 에이전트로… WFA, 마케터를 위한 에이전틱 AI 가이드 발간
items.excerpt: WFA and The Brandtech Group published 'Agents at Work: A Marketer's Guide to Agentic AI'; WFA survey says 96% of brands already use generative or agentic AI, 92% expect efficiency gains and 65% see rising risk, with guidance on autonomy, accountability and human oversight.

items.title: CJ ENM, AI 기반 광고 기술 고도화… VPPL부터 IP 활용한 맞춤형 AI 광고까지
items.excerpt: CJ ENM is upgrading its AI virtual product placement (VPPL), rendering products onto moving actors' clothing in dramas, and producing brand-tailored AI ads from drama IP, bundled with broadcast/OTT/digital media buying.

items.title: In Graphic Detail: How shoppers are adopting AI for product research ahead of Black Friday
items.excerpt: Data on how shoppers use AI chatbots for product discovery ahead of Black Friday, leaving marketers unsure how to shift spend and tactics for the biggest sales period of the year.

items.title: Meta brings Muse AI agent to the UK with retail partners
items.excerpt: Meta's Muse shopping agent launches in the UK with retailer connectors and user approval controls, under ICO and CMA regulatory oversight.

items.title: Natural launches card acceptance for AI agents
items.excerpt: Natural launched Natural Accept, letting AI agents collect card payments via link, embedded checkout or phone - checkout plumbing for agent-led sales.

items.title: "10만원 이하 난방기 찾아줘"…다나와, 챗GPT로 AI 쇼핑 확대
items.excerpt: Danawa connected live product and price data to ChatGPT via an MCP service after Claude; 74% of its generative-AI-referred traffic already comes from ChatGPT.

items.title: 공정위, 애플 '시리' AI기능 지연…부당광고 혐의 심의 착수
items.excerpt: Korea's FTC is reviewing Apple for advertising iPhone 16 AI features as available despite uncertain launch timing; examiners put related sales at 3.35 trillion won and recommended a fine.

items.title: AI로 음식 이미지 만드는 시대…허위·과장 광고 논쟁 가열
items.excerpt: As AI-generated product images spread across restaurants and e-commerce, legal debate grows over false advertising; a Japanese lawyer says AI menu images face the same premiums-and-representations standards as other ad imagery.

items.title: “블랙프라이데이 쇼핑도 AI로”…빅테크 ‘쇼핑 에이전트’ 전쟁
items.excerpt: Amazon negotiates to admit Meta's Muse two months after blocking it, weighing ad-revenue loss against customer churn; orders via AI agents rose 9.5x in 90 days as big tech fights over the purchase decision.

items.title: "AI가 팔고 알리고 응대까지"…플랫폼의 무인화 실험 [정지은의 테크킥]
items.excerpt: Naver, Baemin, Coupang and others are using AI to automate product advertising and even purchase decisions, chasing operating efficiency and profitability.

items.title: SK스토아, AI 쇼호스트와 사람이 함께 상품 판다
items.excerpt: SK Stoa puts its AI show host 'Aisa' into live home-shopping broadcasts on Nov 27, co-hosting and selling alongside human hosts rather than only appearing in pre-made clips.

items.title: Beyond Browsing: How AI Agents Are Rewriting the Rules of Cyber Week Shopping in ANZ
items.excerpt: Salesforce data on the eve of Cyber Week: one in five Australian shoppers now start their shopping journey with AI, with agents doing the legwork but not yet the paying.
